item.title: Clearer account deletion on the web
item.summary: Murph's web deletion page now explains how to remove an account even when the Android app is no longer installed.
item.details: The page keeps deletion controls available without an active subscription or renewed health-data consent, and names what the request covers, category-specific retention targets, external-delivery limits, longer-lived support, security, billing and tax records, and where to request help or partial deletion.
